1. User Request Submission Users request a Blanket Order using the “Blanket Order Request Form ” which captures the necessary information and provides instruction specific to RF and State funded Blanket Orders.

sections.title: 2. Blanket Order Request: Workflow
paragraphs: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 2

The workflow for this request ultimately ends with a Buyer to create the needed Blanket Order C ontract. This request DOES NOT result in a Purchase Order, it is merely a process to collect the needed data and obtain approvals.

Blanket Order R eview Buyer review of request to determine legitimacy and required information Funds Check Standard Funds Check: State / RF Account/Financial Approval Financial Approval: Account / Project Blanket Contract Creation Buyer queue to create internal Procurement Blanket Contract

sections.title: 3. Buyer Requirements for Contract Creation:
paragraphs: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 3

Once the request reaches the “Blanket Contract Creation” queue of the Buyer , they need to create the Internal Procurement Blanket Order Contract . Below are the required permission (s) and TCM elements to facilitate the Contract creation.
1. Buyer(s) need to have “ Contract Manager ” permission . 1.1. Campus Decision: Add permission t o Buyer Role?

2. Campus Contract Work Group specific to “Procurement” (?) 2.1. Campus Decision: Create specific Work Group for Internal Procurement Contracts? 2.2. Temporarily added “Buyers” Role to UB Work Group “Procurement Systems Team” 2.3. A new Work Group can use a designated Number Wheel to assign Contract Numbers . i.e. UB -BLKT -###

3. Campus/Global Contract Type of “Blanket Order” (?) 3.1. Campus Decision: Create a Campus specific TCM Contract Type? 3.2. Temporarily using Global “Blanket Order” Contract Type created for Focus Group.
4. TCM Workflow Adjustments 4.1. Campus Decision: Inter nal P rocurement Contracts to skip “Signature ” workflow? 4.2. No temporary adjustments made in UIT

sections.title: 5. Contract Creation Setup
paragraphs: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 4
Below are the Buyer steps, sections, consideration s and options for creating and editing the draft Blanket Order Contract.
5.1. Contract Header Verify info in #1 , Select a Supplier/Second Par ty in #2, Set Start/End Date (indicated in original request) in #3
Create New Contract:
• Contract Name: Free Text
• Contract Type: As defined in Step 4
• Work Group: As defined in Step 4
• Main Document Template: Optional – N/A

sections.title: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 5
paragraphs: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 5
5.2. How will Contract be applied? By specific SKU, by Search -able Item or other means ?

5.3. Control “Releases” – Budget and Spend User spend (or “releases ”) against the Contract are enforced by setting a “Budget ” (obtained from original approved req uest) and choosing to “Enforce ” it.
If specific Product #/SKU ’s will be used to apply the Contract :
• Applies To > Product/SKU
• Manually add or import SKU ’s to be used
If Contract will be applied using defined “searcha ble ” items :
• Goods and Services > Non -Catalog Items
• Manually add or import items to be searched and placed in Cart

Other Means, Options for Applying Contract: The Con tract can be applied manually (User s election) or automatically based on ANY Purchase made for the contracted Supplier ( Second Party). See : Step 6 Post Executed: In Effect Settings
If Users Contract ed Cart items will exceed the enforced Budget amount, they will see the error below and will not be able to place their order.

paragraphs: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 6
5.4. Control Use/Visibility Determines which User(s) have access / applicability for the Contract . Options include entire Campus, Department , Role or individual Use r(s).

sections.title: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 7
paragraphs: Blanket Order Request Overview – Pg. 7
5.5. Special Stipulations? – PO Clauses If needed, specific PO Clauses can be assigned which will be applied to any “Release ” Purchase Order distributed to the Supplier.
6. Post Executed: In Effect Settings These settings are only available after the Contract is Approved / Executed (non -draft) .
• “Active For Shopping ” must be “Yes ” for the Contract to be usable in ePro
• “Restrict Products To ” must be “Only for Specified Product SKUs or UNSPSC ” if Step 5.2 was used to set Product/SKU OR Non-Catalog Item applicability

• “Automatically Apply Purchases from this Suppler to this Contract ” can be used in conjunction with the Restrict Products To: Any Sup plier Product to either ; Allow the U ser to select the C ontract to apply anytime the Supplier is used OR Automatically apply the Contract anytime the Supplier is used.
